To decrease sodium, limit foods with soy sauce, salt, and
monosodium glutamate (MSG).
Many staples of the Middle Eastern, Indian, and
Pakistani cuisines are low-fat, low-sodium items such as
pita bread, rice, couscous, and lentils.  However, keep in
mind that these foods often are combined with large
amounts of butter, coconut oil, or palm oil.  Request foods
without the added fats and that sauces be put on the side.
Healthful selections include kabobs or fish that is grilled, rice,
couscous, or orzo.
Greek and Mediterranean food is based on pasta, bread,
and rice.  It is often the sauce that accompanies the grain
that adds calories and fat.  Sauces to watch out for include
pesto and cream-based sauces.  Red sauces are usually quite
low in calories and fat.  If ordering a pizza, remember that
the meat and cheese are the culprits for calories and fat.
Order a pizza with one meat item at the most, request half
the cheese, and load on the vegetables.
